cases.criterion: Genuine approved neutral singleton commits only exact configuration through the inherited hook; bytes, command, fields, modes and committed blob are preserved.
Genuine actual layout missing-required, unexpected untracked peer, physical drift and alias are refused before configuration mutation.
Genuine ready singleton cannot authorize mixed configuration and unrelated suite staging; ordinary commit is refused.
Missing real ready authority, stale candidate and unowned completion handle cannot grant a configuration commit.
Exact committed replay is inert; genuine incomplete transition stays held and consumed handle reuse refuses.
cases.limit: Does not prove a partial two-tier write or real legacy twin.
